notes.293r.16: 293r.32: to 'shun holy nights' is to abstain from intercourse on them.

nodes.text: pray. And because this young woman
would not keep herself from her lust for
the sake of the feast, as soon as she came into
the church the devil came into her body
and tormented her. And a priest came and took
the pall from St Sebastian's altar and laid [it]
on her so that the devil would flee. Then
the devil came and tormented the priest, and then the devil went
from the priest back to the woman again. Then
the woman's kinsmen came and called in conjurers
so that they should by conjuring drive the devil
out. And when the conjurers tried to drive the devil
out, she was tormented as if she had a thousand
devils. At last they took her
to a holy bishop, who was called Fortunatus, and
through his prayer the woman was set free.
And therefore every married couple shall respect holy
nights, and fear, as David the prophet says:
